summary: Webull Corporation furnished a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026, attaching its Notice of 2026 General Meeting of Shareholders and Proxy Statement alongside a form of proxy card. The hybrid meeting is scheduled for October 30, 2026 at 2:30 p.m. EDT in St. Petersburg, Florida, with a September 25, 2026 record date for Class A and Class B holders. Proposals include adopting a Sixth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles and a 2026 Employee Share Purchase Plan. The Board recommends voting FOR each proposal. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
